Your holdings: SOXL (-36.28%) and SPAL (-30.82%) are flagged 'SELL' and are leveraged ETFs in deep drawdowns. Margin amplifies these drops, making them critical to address.

Watch: Keep a close eye on bond yield movements and any further hawkish Fed commentary. Also, monitor your leveraged ETFs for accelerated decay.

Bottom line: Prioritize risk management on your leveraged, losing positions in this rising rate environment.
plays: Consider trimming SOXL and SPAL. Both are leveraged, decaying ETFs with significant losses (-36.28%, -30.82%) and are flagged 'SELL'.
